media.title: What the moderator checks
media.text: We check every video before launch. A campaign with issues comes back with an explanation — fix it and send it again.

tariff.title: How to choose
tariff.text: First campaign — “Standard”. Need specific shelves — “Standard + Zones”. Want to play more often — “Premium”. Special terms — “Corporate”.

stores.title: Where the video is seen more often
stores.text: The fewer campaigns a store has, the more often your video plays. More carts — more shoppers see the ad.

zones.title: How zones work
zones.text: Only zone-plan videos play in a zone — yours and other brands on the same plan. Next to each zone you see how many brands are already there.

budget.title: Any questions?
budget.text: A manager will help with the budget, stores and video requirements.

fix.title: The moderator returned the campaign
fix.after: Fix the video and send it again — we’ll check it within a working day.

tariff.title: Choose a plan
tariff.lead: The plan sets where the video plays and the campaign’s minimum budget.
tariff.note: You can change the plan until you send the campaign for review.

features.brandOnly: Only your brand in the zone

stores.title: Choose stores
stores.lead: The video plays on every cart of the chosen stores.
stores.empty: No stores match. Change the search or filters.

zones.title: Shelf zones
zones.lead: The video starts when a shopper with a cart comes to the chosen shelves. Zones are chosen in each store separately.

budget.lead: Set the budget, check the campaign and send it to the moderator. Impressions start right after approval.
budget.label: Campaign budget

corporate.title: Ads at the shelf — on your brand’s terms
corporate.text: An exclusive contract for brands and chains. Reach, zones, formats and budget are agreed with you and fixed in the contract.

promises.reach: Any reach — from a district to the whole country

corporate.whatLead: Everything from the plans on the site — plus what we pick for your brand’s task together with you.

reach.title: Any reach
reach.text: Stores, chains and cities of your choice — from one district to the whole country.

exclusive.title: Category exclusivity
exclusive.text: Only your brand plays in your zones and category — no competitors.

shelves.title: Zones and shelves
shelves.text: The video starts at the shelves with your product in every store of the contract.

shows.title: More impressions
shows.text: Rotation priority and impression frequency fixed in the contract.

formats.title: Your own formats
formats.text: Video series, other lengths, special projects for a product launch.

reports.title: Reports for the brand
